en: Black‑and‑white postcard view across a calm river or lake toward a small town. In the distance are industrial buildings with a smokestack, several houses, and a prominent church with a dome-like tower on a low hill. Reeds and trees frame the water in the foreground. Printed white text in Swedish appears along the bottom edge, including the caption and photographer/publisher information, along with an oval logo.
